title: Tan v. South Texas
disposition_detail: The SJC found TE Aureliano Tan's complaint against South Texas Presbytery administratively out of order because it was prematurely filed with the SJC before the presbytery had heard it. No merits ruling was made. Adopted by vote of 19 concurring, 0 dissenting, 4 absent; approved by the full SJC on March 4, 2004.
first_summary: TE Aureliano Tan's complaint against South Texas Presbytery was dismissed as premature because the presbytery had not yet heard it. The SJC adopted the ruling 19-0, with four absent, and the full SJC approved it on March 4, 2004. The source also contains proposed SJC Manual changes and a dissent.
summary: TE Aureliano Tan filed a complaint against South Texas Presbytery with the SJC before the presbytery had heard it. The SJC found the complaint administratively out of order as prematurely filed, so it reached no merits. The adopted vote was 19 concurring, 0 dissenting, with 4 absent; the full SJC approved the ruling on March 4, 2004. The same pages separately contain proposed SJC Manual changes and a dissent, not a ruling in this complaint.
